Parish Envelopes: As we are approaching the end of the financial year 2026, the new parish envelopes are being prepared. If you did not receive a box last year or are new to the parish area and would like to receive a box for 2027 please contact the parish office. Contributions are used for the maintenance of the three churches and the running costs of the parish. As always, your generosity is very much appreciated. A Time to Remember! Those we love n ever leave us. They remain part of who we are, in the memories we treasure, the lives they touched and the love they left behind. This weekend, as we celebrate the Feast of Christ the King, we gather as a parish community for our annual Mass of Remembrance for all who died during the year. it is a special occasion for families and friends to remember those they have loved and lost. We think of their faces, their voices, the memories we shared and the many ways they touched our lives. Although they are no longer with us, the love we have for them does not end with death. For those who have experienced bereavement, this can be a difficult time, particularly as Christmas approaches. We hope this Mass will offer comfort, strength and an opportunity to remember. A s we celebrate Christ the King, we are reminded that his kingdom is a kingdom of love, peace and eternal life. We commend all our deceased loved ones to his loving care and keep their families in our prayers. Cahersiveen

Some parishioners completed them last year so that will suffice. The parish can claim back the tax on charitable donations of 250 and over. This amounts to approximate €8000 each year and it is invaluable to the parish. Thank you for your generous donations. Please return the forms as soon as you can.
